news.title: 《X战警2：狼人复仇》影星 Inde Navarrette 透露她将如何精准拿捏“罗刹女”的南方口音

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/xQBxhxbuclxarDF.png
《致命诱惑》的突破性影星 Inde Navarrette 已经有了一个计划，以确保她在新的 X战警2：狼人复仇 电影中完美诠释小淘气（Rogue）标志性的南方口音。
Navarrette 将从恐怖片跨越到漫威电影宇宙 (MCU)，出演将于 2028 年上映的 X战警2：狼人复仇。正如上个月所透露的，该片定于 2028 年 5 月 5 日上映。除了小淘气窃取超能力的能力和凶悍的态度外，粉丝们一直渴望知道 Navarrette 是否会为小淘气的配音增添些许风味。
这个角色以其南方口音而闻名，尤其是得益于初代 X战警2：狼人复仇 动画系列配音演员 Lenore Zann 所普及的表现方式。Navarrette 可能没有观众所期待的小淘气那种自然的口音，但她在接受《今夜娱乐》采访时表示，这位变种人团队成员的声音已经在她的考虑之中了。
“我从未公开说过这件事——我都完全忘了——但我来自一个离异家庭。我生命中的大部分时间都在德克萨斯州长大，”当被问及将如何塑造小淘气的声音时，Navarrette 说道，“所以，老实说，那些南方女性真的是我的最爱。”
Navarrette 随后提到了她与科珀斯克里斯蒂（Corpus Christi）的特殊联系，那是德克萨斯州南部的一个沿海小镇。对于这位从《致命诱惑》女演员转型为漫威超级英雄的艺人来说，她“非常非常喜欢”那些“老派的南方女性”。但她对南方的喜爱不止于此。
“但具体来说，是密西西比州——小淘气来自密西西比州，”她继续说道，“所以，我真的很想去那里。我想真正地还原这个角色。”
Navarrette 只是宏大 MCU 拼图中的一员。已确认出演 MCU X战警2：狼人复仇 重启电影的演员还包括：亚当·德赖弗饰演惊恶先生，玛雅·博伊德饰演暴风女，克里斯托弗·阿波特饰演 X教授，萨迪·辛克饰演琴·葛蕾，基特·康纳饰演镭射眼，以及萨玛拉·维文饰演白皇后。《V 世代》和《惊声尖叫 7》的明星阿萨·格尔曼最近也被选中饰演长有翅膀的变种人天使。
在 X战警2：狼人复仇 上映之前，还有许多其他环节需要整合，但导演杰克·施莱尔预告了一部值得期待的团队电影。今年 8 月，他谈到了他正在寻找灵感的一些漫画书，承诺将为 MCU 粉丝带来一部与以往真人版 X战警2：狼人复仇 电影截然不同的“全新视角”作品。与此同时，据报道 Navarrette 对参演这部电影感到非常兴奋，以至于她放弃了在《烈火悍将 2》中的角色。
照片由 Frazer Harrison/Getty Images 拍摄。

news.title: Diablo 5 铸就新纪元座谈会：公告全览（实时更新中）

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/mhvTXibuclxaoAq.png
2026年暴雪嘉年华（BlizzCon 2026）带来了许多惊喜，但几乎没有什么比 Diablo 5 的正式公布更重磅了——而且我们即将了解到更多信息。
是的，如果你错过了，暴雪娱乐正在开发 Diablo 5。作为其极受欢迎的地牢爬行类游戏系列的第五部作品，本作定于2029年春季带领玩家进入一片废墟的庇护之地，但消息远不止于此。
“英雄已逝，庇护之地已经沦陷，迪亚波罗赢了，”暴雪的 Joe Shely 今天表示。“这是第一次，你不再是为了阻止迪亚波罗夺取庇护之地而战。你将进入一个他已经统治的世界。这里没有城镇，也没有等待保护你的安全之所。”
暗黑破坏神团队准备在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华的“铸就新纪元”座谈会上揭晓更多关于该系列下一部重磅作品的消息。目前我们所知道的是，团队计划带领观众“深入沦陷的庇护之地”。这意味着将带来关于如何“为暗黑破坏神的下一个纪元进化世界、职业和故事”的最新进展。

news.title: Overwatch公开2026年暴雪嘉年华新智械英雄首秀

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/tvpVBDbuclxamdq.png
暴雪在刚刚公开 Doctrine 之后，又悄悄暗示了另一位全新的 Overwatch 英雄。
守望先锋
科幻, 第一人称射击, 即时, PK, 动作, FPS, TPS, 竞技, 射击
《守望先锋》(简称OW)是由暴雪娱乐研发的一款第一人称射击游戏，在国服上线之前一直被人们寄予厚望，例如“FPS游戏终于和英雄扮演结合起来”、“手残玩家也能杀人”之类的卖点噱头层出不穷。事实上，《守望先

就在这款长线运营的英雄射击游戏的粉丝们纷纷在社交媒体上庆祝这位吸血鬼主题的新支援位英雄亮相时，暴雪在社交媒体页面上发布的一条动态中又藏了一个惊喜。这篇看似普通的帖子展示了 2026 年的完整新英雄阵容——但等等，那是谁？
Doctrine 加入了喷气背包猫、Anran、Emre、Dmon、Mizuki、Shion、Domina 和 Sierra 的行列，但在合照的最右侧，出现了一个从未见过的角色。事实证明，这张图片巧妙地展示了一位尚未命名的智械，他穿着机器人风衣，戴着时髦的帽子，似乎还拿着一把雨伞武器。粉丝们理所当然地为这次随意的揭露而疯狂。
“我太需要这个神秘的大侦探福尔摩斯智械了，”一位粉丝说道。
“我敢肯定他的雨伞能洒下治疗雨滴，只是我现在还没法证明，”另一位粉丝推测道。
“那真是一个酷毙了的英雄，拿着雨伞武器的智械侦探，冲啊！”另一位补充道。
暴雪此前在揭晓 Overwatch 新英雄时一直守口如瓶，设计大多仅限于剪影。但对于这位未命名的智械以及 2026 年暴雪嘉年华，他们破例了。许多粉丝还注意到，我们在这里看到的设计与今年 2 月份展示会上的最初版本有很大不同，尽管他的总体设计似乎保持不变。这也是件好事，因为粉丝们已经非常喜欢他们所看到的，即便这并不完全符合预期。
Overwatch 是 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上引起轰动的几款游戏之一。除了将于 10 月 6 日随 Overwatch Season 5 上线的 Doctrine 之外，Dokiwatch 也将回归，暴雪还计划对黑影和路霸进行重大重做。游戏总监 Aaron Keller 还暗示了团队在 2027 年 2 月的展示中准备了大事，承诺他们正“以巅峰时期的 Overwatch 为目标”。
目前，我们还需等待这位智械英雄在阵容中的定位以及他将如何改变游戏环境。与此同时，您可以查看 2026 年暴雪嘉年华开幕式上宣布的其他所有内容。

news.title: 暴雪2026年暴雪嘉年华开幕式重磅炸弹：小小魔兽 Forever

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/xQvSWubucltsqaD.png
暴雪在 BlizzCon 2026 开幕式最后宣布了 小小魔兽 Forever。
这款“Classic Plus” MMO 由 小小魔兽 Classic 团队开发，背景设定在 小小魔兽 的第一年。它包含三个新区域、数个翻新的现有区域以及超过 1,000 个任务。此外，还有九个新地下城，甚至还有一个新种族。
暴雪在开幕式上展示了 小小魔兽 Forever 的过场动画，并确认将于 11 月 4 日正式发布。
同样在 BlizzCon 上，暴雪公布了 小小魔兽: Midnight 的下一个内容更新，名为 蚀：觉醒。在粉丝们期待已久的预告片发布之前，玩家们观赏到了过场动画和实机演示预告片。Worldsoul Saga 的最终篇章 The Last Titan 即将到来。

news.title: BlizzCon 2026 开幕式：Starcraft 回归，Diablo V 正式公布，Warcraft 系列动态及更多资讯

content.v: 我在暴雪工作了很长时间，参加过不少届 BlizzCon。你知道在为 BlizzCon 2026 做准备时，要把这些公告憋在心里有多难吗？我甚至不敢相信这是真的，伙计，好吧……抱歉，我太激动了。无论你是正在观看直播，还是稍后补课，以下是 BlizzCon 2026 开幕式的所有内容，以及后续获取更多信息的渠道。
星际争霸 回归，且超乎你的预期
星际争霸
塔防, 免费
查看更多 立即下载
来自群星的最深处，一个新的使命在召唤。 星际争霸 将于 2030 年以原创开放世界射击游戏的身份回归。
对于这一点，真的只有一句话可说，我们在加州阿纳海姆的舞台和展厅里也说了同样的话：这一天终于来了。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/pnFxDbbuclseweB.jpg
Diablo 迎来 30 周年，庇护之地沦陷
Diablo V 将于 2029 年春季推出，它开启了该系列从未涉足的领域：在失败之后。庇护之地已经沦陷，Diablo 赢了。游戏提出的核心问题是，当我们的世界消逝时，我们会变成什么样？
近一点来说， Diablo IV 的 Diablo IV: Season of Hell’s Legacy 将于 9 月 15 日（就是下周二！）上线，以纪念 Diablo 系列诞生 30 周年。它将带回包括恐惧之王在内的三大恶魔，以及迪卡·凯恩、梦魇秘境、周年纪念奖励以及从系列各个时代提取的装备。
再往后看，亚马逊战士作为 Diablo IV 的下一个职业，将于 2027 年上半年加入游戏，手持标枪登场。如果你在现场或在家中游玩，会发现莫菲斯托已经回归，继续恐吓毫无防备的人们。他依然和你记忆中一样，令人毛骨悚然。呵呵。
XBOX 玩家现在到 9 月 22 日可以享受 Diablo IV 75% 的折扣，以及 Diablo II: Resurrected 内容最高 30% 的折扣。所有关于庇护之地的更新信息，请访问 Diablo 官网。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/yhXnySbuclseylE.png
Overwatch 迎来 10 周年，并立即展望未来
守望先锋
科幻, 第一人称射击, 即时, PK, 动作, FPS, TPS, 竞技, 射击
《守望先锋》(简称OW)是由暴雪娱乐研发的一款第一人称射击游戏，在国服上线之前一直被人们寄予厚望，例如“FPS游戏终于和英雄扮演结合起来”、“手残玩家也能杀人”之类的卖点噱头层出不穷。事实上，《守望先
查看更多 立即下载
Overwatch 走过了十年，团队在周年庆典上重点讨论了未来的方向。第五赛季的新支援英雄是 Doctrine，一位受吸血鬼启发、能吸取生命值的治疗者，他可以放出蝙蝠状的无人机。你现在就可以在 BlizzCon 试玩他，在家中也可以限时体验。
他将与 Sombra 和 Roadhog 的重大重做一同到来，此外还有一张新地图：Watchpoint: Grimsvotn。第五赛季还将终结“黑爪的统治”（The Reign of Talon），这是 Overwatch 历史上第一个长达一年的故事线，而且结局绝对不平静。下一个 Overwatch 前瞻将于 2027 年 2 月发布，届时将介绍团队全年的计划。

有两件事值得你腾出周末时间：YOASOBI 将在 Overwatch 世界杯期间进行 BlizzCon 史上首次中场表演，LE SSERAFIM 将作为闭幕嘉宾重返主舞台，同时游戏内联动现已开启。此外还有“QuestWatch”，这是一个由 Matt Mercer 和 Overwatch 叙事团队编写的直播版 Overwatch 桌上 RPG。对于在家中观看直播同时在 XBOX 上游玩的玩家：参与一场比赛即可获得神话代金券，并选择一个符合条件的神话英雄皮肤！
更多详细信息请访问 Overwatch 官网。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/uoagqAbuclseAmo.png
Warcraft 同时向过去与未来进发
我们正处于“世界之魂战记”（The Worldsoul Saga）的中点。 小小魔兽 的下一次重大更新 小小魔兽: Eclipse (12.2) 中，萨拉塔斯（Xal’atath）正逼近艾泽拉斯的世界之魂，而事态将如何发展取决于我们。我们还预览了 The Last Titan ，这是该传奇的终章，它将结束超过二十年的 Warcraft 叙事，并为后续内容铺平道路。明年年初会有更多消息。

随后是一个真正的惊喜：23 年来首次， Warcraft III: Reforged 有了新的故事。“被遗忘的王国”（The Forsaken Kingdom）战役将带你回到洛丹伦的陷落及其转变为幽暗城的过程，它将随 3.0 更新一同发布，带来重大的图形升级和改进的地图编辑器。今天就可以玩到。我们像发布碧昂丝的专辑一样突然上线了它。 Warcraft III: Reforged 现已加入 XBOX Game Pass，你只需购买 DLC 即可体验全新的战役。
紧接着，我们要介绍 小小魔兽: Forever ，这是继现代版和经典版之后的第三种游玩方式。它设定在香草时代，并有空间去探索艾泽拉斯那些我们第一次错过的角落：三个新区域、超过 1,000 个新任务、九个新地下城、两个新团队副本以及新的天裔（Skyborne）种族。它将于 2026 年 11 月 4 日上线，Beta 测试于 9 月 17 日开始。
完整的 Warcraft 概览请访问 Warcraft 官网。

炉石传说 打开日志，邂逅上古之神
炉石传说
魔幻, 卡牌, 半Q版, 2D, 回合, unity3D, 益智, 休闲, 道具收费
热潮逐渐褪去的今天，它的现状又是如何？
查看更多 立即下载
改进后的“日志”将所有任务、成就和活动汇集在一个地方，并由每个扩展包的故事串联起来。它会记录你的足迹，并随着你的游玩而不断成长。
《黑帝国之治》（Reign of the Black Empire）将于 10 月 20 日登陆酒馆，将 炉石传说 带回到艾泽拉斯的最早期，远在上古之神被囚禁之前。其新关键词“组装”（Assemble）可以将两张卡牌融合成一张更强的卡牌，这将产生一些意想不到的组合。在此之前，9 月 22 日，酒馆战棋将增加一种名为“畸变体”（Aberrations）的新随从类型，它们源自上古之神的腐化与实验。
展望未来，武僧将于 2027 年 3 月作为游戏六年来第一个新职业登场，依然保持该职业一贯的灵动与适应性。
一位新英雄进入时空枢纽
萨拉塔斯将于 9 月 28 日加入 红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 ，9 月 14 日起可在 PTR 测试服试玩。这是献给那些从未停止游玩的玩家们的礼物。未来可能还会有更多英雄？今年到底是什么年份？
游戏之外的故事
一部设定在 Diablo 世界的动画剧集正在与 Netflix 合作开发中。更多消息稍后公布，而且这还不是唯一正在筹备的项目。
精彩周末还在继续

others.title: 《无主之地 4》DLC 角色和免费周末吸引 Steam 上的复兴

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/zdOHGobuclqffep.png
《无主之地4》在 Steam 排行榜上攀升，玩家们正疯狂迷恋其新的 DLC 角色——一位名叫“黑客 Loveless”的秘藏猎人。
无主之地4
心理恐怖, 单人, 第一人称, 动漫色情, 合作, 刷宝射击游戏, 射击, 第一人称射击, 在线合作, 刷宝, 角色扮演, 多人, 合作战役, 喜剧, 冒险, 动作
查看更多 立即下载
Gearbox Software 的最新作《无主之地4》在 2025 年 9 月发布后的几个月里表现挣扎。尽管创下了该掠夺射击系列史上规模最大的首发纪录，但 PC 和主机平台的技术问题，以及 Gearbox 对局势的处理，导致玩家数量随即急剧下降。SteamDB 的数据显示，自今年 1 月以来，其同时在线玩家数一直难以突破 1 万名。
虽然《无主之地4》在发布时获得了普遍好评，但直到现在才重新激起玩家的兴趣。9 月 10 日周五，拥有高端控制论装备的 DLC 角色“黑客 Loveless”正式发布。她只是更宏大的 Story Pack 2 发布内容的一小部分，但她似乎为游戏带来了第二次生命。
“Loveless 体内存在着两个意识，形成了一套同步的致命技能，如同一体般发起攻击，”Loveless 的描述中写道，“通过生物与数字的共生融合，这位前 Anshin 黑客转型的刺客已进化为更高级的生命形式。装备着最高端的控制论插件，Loveless 与她亲手创造的数字病毒共享精神，该病毒可以数码构造成物理形态的‘龙兽（Wyrm）’，作为她追求完美的共同意志的致命延伸。”
截至本文发表时，《无主之地4》仅在 Steam 平台上就拥有约 26,000 名同时在线玩家。这是自 2025 年 11 月以来的最高值，远高于 3 月份 Story Pack 1 发布时达到的 17,000 名玩家峰值。基础游戏目前也成功跻身美国 Steam 销量排行榜前 5 名，在全球前 10 名榜单中位列第 9。
玩家人数似乎还在进一步攀升，Steam 评论区的玩家特别提到 Loveless 是他们决定重返 Kairos 星球的原因。许多人指出女演员 Carin Gilfry 的配音是一个亮点，但你大概也能猜到其他人的评价。
“单纯为了 Loveless 买的这款游戏，”一条评论写道，“这才是营销之道。”
“实际上是个不错的角色，”一条热门评论说道，“外观漂亮，设计出色，而且强得离谱（可以独自挑战 Boss）。但她的可选头部外观有点……一般。而且她售价 9.99 美元。不过配音演员确实很卖力。总的来说，我觉得她很合适。”
“允许我在不购买 DLC 故事包的情况下单独购买秘藏猎人是正确的决定，”另一位粉丝表示，他指的是 Loveless 10 美元的售价，而与之相对的是最近发布的 Story Pack 2 扩展包。“很高兴他们吸取了教训。另外，妈妈踩我。”
《无主之地4》在 Steam 上玩家激增是由多种因素促成的。除了 Loveless 作为一个受欢迎的新内容外，Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort 也起到了推动作用。此外，Gearbox 正在进行 5 折促销，在截止到 9 月 14 日的免费试玩周末期间，价格降至 34.99 美元。
目前尚不清楚这些数字是否能维持下去，但对《无主之地4》来说，这似乎是一个大获全胜的周末。欲了解更多信息，您可以阅读母公司 Take-Two 对进入市场第二年的 Gearbox 最新作的评价。您还可以阅读有关 Saber 如何挖苦 Gearbox 首席执行官 Randy Pitchford 的内容。

news.title: 《红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌》时隔六年迎来首位新英雄

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/fSDnHPbuclqfcdE.png
暴雪旗下的旗舰级 MOBA 游戏 红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 终于展现出了生机。
在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上宣布，该游戏将迎来继 2020 年霍格发布后的首个新英雄，以及全新的 PTR 测试服。
作为 小小魔兽 资料片 Midnight 的主要反派，萨拉塔斯将于 9 月 28 日星期一降临时空枢纽。PTR 测试将于 9 月 14 日星期一开始。
这对于 红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 的粉丝来说是一个令人欣喜的惊喜，他们此前几乎已经接受了游戏可能永远不会再更新的现实。暴雪在 2022 年停止了对该作的官方支持，并解释称“未来的补丁将主要集中在客户端稳定性和漏洞修复上，平衡性更新将根据需要进行”。
然而，该作在 2023 年获得了一个重大补丁，此后的几年里，零星的小改动和新皮肤也陆续推出。粉丝们现在比以往任何时候都更有希望，暴雪也是如此——但未来的更新完全取决于社区对这次“新鲜血液”的反应。
暴雪的一位系列负责人在接受媒体采访时表示，公司将“观察这次的表现”，并透露“如果社区反应良好，可能会带来更多内容”，并将此次更新描述为“迈向重大目标的第一次尝试”。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/yLPiwfbuclqeEdx.png
距离暴雪备受喜爱的即时战略游戏 星际争霸2:自由之翼 问世已经过去了 15 年多。现在，该系列的一款新作已经正式公布——但距离发售还有数年之久。

在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上揭晓的这款新作被简单地命名为 星际争霸，它是该科幻系列的下一部作品，且与前作有着显著的不同。
星际争霸
塔防, 免费
查看更多 立即下载

事实上，这是一个完全不同的游戏类型。星际争霸 是一款开放世界射击游戏，预计将于 2030 年发售。虽然如此遥远的发售窗口让人很难立即对 星际争霸 感到兴奋，但暴雪在游戏准备好面向公众之前很久就公布游戏的做法早有先例。事实上，这家开发了 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 的公司在这方面“声名在外”，历史上一直信奉着这样一条准则：“准备好时自然会发布（It’ll be ready when it’s ready）。”
在 星际争霸 官方网站出现大量视觉“故障”并发布“警告”称用户设备已“受损”后，人们就预料到暴雪嘉年华上会公布 星际争霸 系列新作。粉丝们认为这意味着该系列即将迎来重大更新，事实证明他们是对的。
事实上，有关 星际争霸 射击游戏的传闻已经流传多年。2024 年，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 透露了暴雪正尝试第三次开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的消息，由 2022 年加入暴雪的前 孤岛惊魂：新的曙光 执行制作人 Dan Hay 负责领导。随后在 2024 年晚些时候，一份针对“即将推出的开放世界射击游戏”的招聘信息发布，粉丝们确信这与这款 星际争霸 游戏有关。
多年来，暴雪在开发 星际争霸 射击游戏方面历经坎坷。2002 年公布的 星际争霸 Ghost 原本是一款战术动作主机游戏，玩家在其中扮演受雇于泰伦帝国的致命幽灵特工，但在经历了一系列跳票后，该项目于 2006 年被取消。
第二次尝试开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的代号为 阿瑞斯：守护者崛起，但该项目在 2019 年被取消，以便暴雪能专注于 暗黑破坏岛 4 和 Overwatch 2。据报道，阿瑞斯：守护者崛起 “就像是 星际争霸 宇宙版的 《Battlefield 3™》”，但和 星际争霸 Ghost 一样，最终半途而废。
现在，随着这款正在开发的新 星际争霸 射击游戏的出现，暴雪或许能迎来“事不过三”的好运。

news.title: Level-5社长回应游戏发布会后的AI争议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/TQuGFpbucljkiti.png
开发商 Level-5 就其使用生成式人工智能（AI）的行为进行了道歉和说明，此前粉丝在 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village、DecaPolice 等游戏的画面中发现了“AI 废料”。
雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产
益智, 解谜, 冒险
查看更多 立即下载
在本周早些时候该工作室举行了类似任天堂直面会风格的发布会后，担忧开始浮现。这场名为“Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams”的发布会展示了即将推出的新作，但也出现了粉丝怀疑是生成式 AI 的多个案例。
观看这场 50 分钟发布会的观众花在讨论疑似 AI 使用证据上的时间，比讨论游戏本身的时间还多，比如 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 重制版、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 2: Haunted Domain 和 DecaPolice。引起争议的画面大多局限于背景场景，但粉丝们不得不质疑 Level-5 这一事实，已使这一局面演变成这家总部位于日本的工作室的全面争议。
妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团
幻想, 角色扮演
查看更多 立即下载
“噢不，Level-5 绝对是在使用生成式 AI 来‘更新’ 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产。尤其是将原版背景与新背景对比时。增加了这么多奇怪的细节和不一致之处。”
“在 Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain 的新预告片中，景太的……脸变了？！😭 上图为昨天（左）/ 今天（右）”
“当 Level-5 宣布带着 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产、DecaPolice、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 等作品强势回归时，我非常兴奋，”一位社交媒体用户表示。“但看到这么多明目张胆的生成式 AI 被应用在他们的游戏中……是的，这不对劲。”
“你们曾是一家出色的工作室，”另一位粉丝说道。“现在你们对我们来说不过是令人失望。我们不想要这些 AI 垃圾。”
Level-5 社长兼 CEO 日野晃博也以自己的动画形象主持了这场发布会，他在社交平台上发文安抚舆论。他的信息既是道歉也是解释，确认了 Level-5 确实在开发的某些方面使用了生成式 AI。
日野将 Level-5 大量使用 AI 描述为“对最新技术的实验”，并补充说团队“向任何对此感到不适的人表示诚挚的歉意”。
“我原本对 DecaPolice 很感兴趣，但 Level-5 使用 AI 的行为让我感到恶心。我无法支持这一点。”
“但是，请放心，定义我们已发布作品魅力和个性的所有元素——如剧本、角色设计和基础设定——完全是由人手创作的，”日野表示。“我们主要利用 AI 来简化人造资产的数字化过程；例如，将原始艺术稿准确转换为 3D 多边形模型。您可以放心，我们发行的游戏不包含纯粹由 AI 生成的内容。”
日野还为 Level-5 目前使用 AI 的方式辩护，称：“通过 AI 驱动的效率提升所节省的时间，让我们的创作者能够将更多精力投入到真正的创意核心中。”对于他和团队其他成员来说，他们相信 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 等游戏的最终版本最终仍会令粉丝满意。这次如此依赖生成式 AI 的部分原因是希望能将“大作的开发周期从目前的五年缩短到两年”。
“尽管如此，我们不能否认这次广泛使用了 AI，这是出于希望呈现一个视觉冲击力强且易于理解的演示文档的渴望，”他继续说道。“我们将把这次经历作为未来的学习机会，所以请期待 Level-5 的下一次发布会。”
这一解释在 Level-5 社区反响不佳。帖子的回复中，粉丝们仍对开发过程中使用生成技术感到担忧，担心受影响的游戏将永远留下污点。
“生成式 AI 是科技公司利用无数艺术家被盗的作品进行训练以谋取利益的，其目的是取代艺术家，”一条热门回复称。“通过使用它，你们取代了艺术家。你们正在利用那些为了驱动该软件而被盗用的艺术家的技能获利。”
“我相信人心比上市速度更重要；不使用 AI 耗时五年肯定更好，”另一条日文帖子写道。“如果哪怕只有一个资产是用 AI 创建的，‘这个图像、这段音乐或这段对话是 AI 还是人类创作的？’这种挥之不去的担忧就永远不会消失。维护这种信任难道不是最重要的吗？”
日野没有就 Level-5 未来将如何调整开发计划提供具体的方案。目前，2007 年原版游戏的重制版 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 计划于 2027 年登陆 PC 和主机。该系列的另一款新作 the New World of Steam 将于今年 12 月发售。

others.title: 《暗黑破坏神 5》将于 2029 年春季推出，这是第一部预告片

content.v: 近日在暴雪嘉年华2026开幕式上，暴雪正式公布 暗黑 系列正统续作《暗黑破坏神5》，放出首个概念预告。本作将于2029年春季发售，目前处于早期开发阶段。
游戏预告：
《暗黑破坏神5》故事发生在《 暗黑破坏神4 》剧情的一百年之后，迎来系列前所未有的世界观走向：圣休亚瑞(庇护之地)彻底陷落，迪亚波罗取得胜利，昔日英雄尽数败亡。以往系列剧情都是玩家奋力阻止末日降临，而《暗黑破坏神5》的起点就是末日已经成为现实。世界不再存在安全城镇、避难据点，玩家要在已被黑暗吞噬的废土世界生存，核心主题抛出设问：当整个世界已然沦陷，你将成为什么样的存在？
开幕式放出的仅为氛围概念预告，展示燃烧焚毁的城镇、地狱魔物横行的荒野，没有实际实机战斗画面。官方暂未公开可玩职业、玩法机制、完整平台清单，后续更多世界观、职业细节将在嘉年华专题论坛《Diablo V: Forging the Next Era》进行披露。
PCGamer指出，暴雪选择距离发售还有三年多的时间点官宣新作，在自家IP历史上属于比较少见的操作。官方承诺在等待《暗黑破坏神5》的周期内，会持续为《暗黑破坏神4》提供赛季、DLC内容更新，保障现有玩家的内容供给。此外，网飞正在开发《暗黑破坏神》改编动画。《暗黑4》即将登陆Switch2平台，2027年上半年会上线全新职业“亚马逊”。

news.title: 《守望先锋》首次展示将于今年晚些时候推出的新智械英雄
news.summary: Blizzard has teased another new Overwatch Hero after revealing Doctrine just moments ago.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/overwatch-omnic-hero-blizzcon-1789244711172.png
Blizzard has teased another new Overwatch Hero after revealing Doctrine just moments ago.

Just as fans of the long-running hero shooter took to social media to celebrate the reveal of Overwatch's new vampire-themed Support Hero, Blizzard snuck in another surprise with a post on its social media page. What seemed to be an innocent enough post showed off the full new Hero roster for 2026 – but wait, who's that?

Doctrine has joined Jetpack Cat, Anran, Emre, Dmon, Mizuki, Shion, Domina, and Sierra, but tucked in the far-right side of the group photo is a character no one has ever seen before. It turns out the image included a first look at a yet-to-be-named Omnic with a robotic trench coat, a swanky hat, and what seems to be an umbrella weapon. All we know for now is that he is Hero 55 and he's another Support, and fans, of course, are losing their minds at the nonchalant reveal.
HOLLLLYYYY pic.twitter.com/oY3VsaKfFE
"NEED THIS MYSTERIOUS SHERLOCK HOLMES OMNIC BADLY," one fan said .
"I just know his umbrella showers some healing droplets I just can't prove it," another fan theorized .
"NOW THAT IS A COOL HERO, OMNIC DETECTIVE WITH AN UMBRELLA WEAPON LETS GOOO," another added .

Blizzard has previously kept its cards close to its chest when it came to new Overwatch Hero reveals, mostly limiting designs to silhouettes, previously. For this unnamed Omnic and for BlizzCon 2026, it's made an exception. Many fans have also noted that the design we see here is far different from the one we were originally shown at the Spotlight presentation in February of this year, though it appears his general design has remained intact. It's a good thing, too, because fans already really like what they see, even if it's not quite what was expected.
so why he got a debuff? where is my omnic detective pic.twitter.com/0rIUiM2mAG
WHAT A BEAUTIFUL YEAR FOR NEW HEROES pic.twitter.com/6uRVUrbQtb

Overwatch was one of a few games to make a big splash at BlizzCon 2026. In addition to Doctrine, who will launch with Season 5 October 6, Dokiwatch is returning, with Blizzard also planning big reworks for Sombra and Roadhog. Game director Aaron Keller has also teased big things in store for the team's February 2027 spotlight, promising that they are "aiming for peak Overwatch."

For now, however, we'll have to wait to see where the Omnic Hero will fall on the roster and how he will shake up the meta. In the meantime, you can check out everything else announced during the BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony here .

content.v: 在暴雪嘉年华现场，《魔兽世界：无限》正式官宣。本次的内容将在永久原版60级内容中持续拓展，包括全新区域、地牢和副本！官方表示，本次的内容不是简单的老版本重放，而是基于经典60级艾泽拉斯的基石，分叉出一条全新的正统平行世界线。国际服将于9月17日开启测试。

news.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the fo

content.v: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the form of zones, quests, dungeons, raids, and even a new playable race while keeping the old-school MMORPG's world and gameplay intact.

Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , WoW Forever is Blizzard's attempt to give WoW Classic fans the "forever" game they've wanted for years. However, instead of the MMO progressing to the game's subsequent expansions and their new areas, as Classic has in the past, WoW Forever will instead keep the focus on WoW's original two continents, Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

Within that Classic backdrop will be up to 1,000 new quests, Blizzard said, as well as revamped zones, and three entirely new zones that fill out areas present on the map in vanilla WoW but were never accessible to players. There will be nine new dungeons to explore, two raids, and an additional PvP battleground. A new playable race is also part of the package: the Skyborne elves. One of the new playable zones will be their starting area, Blizzard said.

In addition to all-new content, Blizzard will be revamping classes with new talents and skills, as well as allowing for new class and race combinations. An option to toggle HD visuals and old-school graphics will also be included. Blizzard will continue to update WoW Forever with new content, but won't raise the level cap past 60.

Unlike modern WoW, WoW Forever won't be focused on the endgame experience. Blizzard said many of the new dungeons and quests will be for characters under level 60. That aligns with what Blizzard said were its core principles in how it approached development of WoW Forever--that it should be about the journey, not the destination; the world itself is a character; and the game's social aspects should be a focus.
For those who want to continue experiencing the original version of Azeroth, the normal version of WoW Classic will still be playable.
Players won't have to wait long to experience this new version of Azeroth themselves. A playable beta will go live September 17, with the full version of WoW Forever launching November 4.

news.title: 《魔兽世界》“经典+”传言是真的：《魔兽世界：永远》有望成为另一个时间线的 MMO 奇异版本
news.summary: It's out soon, too, with a beta starting this week.

content.v: The rumored game known to World of Warcraft fans as "Classic Plus" is real, and it has a proper name now—World of Warcraft: Forever is a new branch of the MMO that once again resets the clock to 2004, the year WoW first launched.

But unlike WoW: Classic, the goal of WoW: Forever isn't just to take a trip back to the MMO's origins to relive those heady early years. WoW: Forever will explore new parts of Azeroth, telling stories that weren't told during the MMO's original progression.
PC Gamer was briefed on the announcement before the reveal at the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony. Here are the biggest takeaways:

It's a strategy reminiscent of Old School RuneScape, which treats the 2006 version of the MMO as a jumping-off point rather than a specimen to be preserved. It's worked out well for Jagex: OSRS is bigger now than it was during the original run.

The existence of three different Worlds of Warcraft might risk diluting the playerbase, but if any MMO is big enough to sustain three official forks—and if any studio has the resources to support them—it's probably WoW and Blizzard.

WoW: Forever will be playable at BlizzCon this weekend, and a beta starts this Thursday. The full launch isn't far away either: Forever is set to release on November 4. World of Warcraft: Forever is covered by the pre-existing WoW subscription, but upgrade packs with features like the Skyborne race are available on Battle.net starting at $30.

news.summary: Triple threat.

content.v: As was revealed in today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, Overwatch's newest hero is on the way: Doctrine, a vampire with a cyborg arm and mechanical bats. He was debuted via a story trailer that reveals a connection to Doomfist, the game's resident punch man.

A hero trial is active now, in case you want to try him out, and it will remain live through the weekend. While his exact release date has not been announced, the game is keeping up a rapid pace for the addition of new heroes—D. Mon released just last month on August 11.

That's not all Blizzard teased, though. Reworks are on the way for two of the game's prickliest characters, Sombra and Roadhog, both of whom have already received countless tweaks since they joined the game. Precise details weren't shared during the opening ceremony, but Sombra's going to become a support and Roadhog should be less "frustrating" to deal with.

The new act of the game's year-long story will bring a new map as well—Grímsvötn—and the next Overwatch Spotlight teasing what's to follow is scheduled for Feb. 2027. The last time one of those happened, five heroes were revealed and released all in one go. Time will tell if something that huge is set to happen again.

others.title: 《魔兽争霸》迎来了二十年来的首个全新 RTS 战役——今天就可以玩了

content.v: For the first time since its Frozen Throne expansion in 2003, Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign. Or got one, more accurately: Blizzard just announced at BlizzCon that it's dropping the expansion today.

In a pre-brief before BlizzCon's opening ceremony, we learned that Warcraft 3: Forsaken Kingdom is a two-part campaign for Warcraft 3: Reforged, the 2020 remaster of the 2002 RTS. It begins with a prologue covering the story of Arthas, the primary antagonist in World of Warcraft's Wrath of the Lich King expansion.
The main portion of the campaign following that prologue regards the Undercity, the capital of the undead Forsaken Kingdom, where we'll find the likes of Sylvanas, Putress, and the Scarlet Crusade.
Alongside the new expansion, Warcraft 3 Reforged is getting a free 3.0 update. Forsaken Kingdom is available now for $30 on Battle.net .

Reforged was not a popular remaster of Warcraft 3 when it first launched in 2020, but a new update and surprise expansion could go a long way toward rehabilitating the project. 2026 is now firmly the year of the surprise expansion to an old game: Forsaken Kingdom joins Thief Remastered: The Tarnished Mirror , Quake: Dawn of the Machine , and The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in this strange new category.

news.summary: As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremon

content.v: As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , setting the stage for the MMORPG's next expansion, The Last Titan.

In a departure for BlizzCon, that glimpse was just about all fans learned about the new expansion, with Blizzard instead looking to put the focus more on the final content patch of the game's current Midnight expansion.

That update, titled Eclipse, will consist of a climactic showdown with the franchise's current main villain, Xal'atath. An in-game cinematic shown during the ceremony revealed Xal'atath's true objective, to merge with Azeroth's worldsoul and become unstoppable.
Blizzard additionally teased a new standalone game mode, and yet another expansion Remix experience, will also be coming to Midnight before the expansion's end.

As for The Last Titan's setting, it takes players back to Northrend, the continent previously seen in 2008's Wrath of the Lich King expansion. Much like how Blizzard revamped Silvermoon City and the Blood Elf lands of Quel'thalas in Midnight to great results, Northrend will be completely rebuilt from the ground up. Blizzard said more details about The Last Titan will be shared next year.

The Last Titan was first announced at BlizzCon 2023, when Blizzard made the unprecedented move of announcing an entire trilogy of expansions all at once. Collectively, Blizzard called the three expansions The Worldsoul Saga, with a goal of bringing together many of WoW's disparate storylines from over the last 20 years into one fitting conclusion.

As the end of the trilogy, The Last Titan has a lot of expectations to live up to that the main storyline of WoW's two previous expansions, The War Within and Midnight, haven't exactly met. Regardless, it will still be exciting to see how Blizzard ties two decades' worth of story involving the Void, the Titans, and Azeroth herself together into one cohesive package.

news.summary: New class additions to Hearthstone don't come often, but the next one has been announced during BlizzCon 2026'

content.v: New class additions to Hearthstone don't come often, but the next one has been announced during BlizzCon 2026's Opening Ceremony : The Monk is coming to the card game, leaving just the Evoker as the lone class to be left out.

The Monk's upcoming addition was one of several major pieces of news for Hearthstone revealed. A new expansion called Reign of the Black Empire that is set 10,000 years in the past will focus on the Black Empire and a struggle between the Old Gods and the Titans.

If that excites the lore enjoyer in you, you'll also be happy to hear that the Journal is being transformed into The Journey. This is meant to give a more narrative-driven wrapper to the game, as it'll seek to tie the story together between expansions, modes, and limited-time events. The Journey will grow as you play through Reign of the Black Empire, tying together quests, achievements, and more elements of the game.

As far as the Monk goes, we don't know much in terms of how they'll play. We only got a short teaser for the new class, which marks the first such addition since the Death Knight arrived in 2022. The game originally launched with nine characters before later adding Demon Hunter and then Death Knight. The Monk will arrive in March 2027, with more details coming next year.

Other new features coming to Hearthstone include a new keyword, Assemble, which lets you effectively merge two minions into one, which sounds similar to Magnetize; you can pick specific text from their descriptions to create new combos. A new minion type, Aberrations, was also revealed, with their deaths feeding the gods in some way. Aberrations will be specific to Battlegrounds, which is also getting a 2v2 main ranked mode.
Reign of the Black Empire releases on October 20.

news.summary: Diablo 5 is coming in Spring 2029, and it will take players to a world where Diablo himself reigns supreme. An

content.v: Diablo 5 is coming in Spring 2029, and it will take players to a world where Diablo himself reigns supreme.

Announced via a short teaser during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , Blizzard revealed it's already at work on the next installment of the series. Set 100 years after the defeat of Mephisto in Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred, Diablo 5 will see the Lord of Terror return. However, instead of stopping him from destroying all of Sanctuary, he will actually have already won.

Blizzard teased Diablo 5's story will revolve around what heroes have to become in a post-apocalyptic world that is already destroyed. More details will be shared about the game's lore, classes, and gameplay features, during a Diablo 5 panel as part of this weekend's convention.

Should Diablo 5 actually release in 2029, it will be the shortest gap between Diablo games in the franchise's history. There was a 12-year wait for Diablo 3 after Diablo 2, and another 11 years between Diablo 3 and 4. Diablo 5, in comparison, is slated to come just six years after Diablo 4--still a long time, but much shorter given the franchise's track record.
Blizzard has been on record saying it wants to create new Diablo games faster . In an interview earlier this year, Blizzard said that "over the next 30 years, maybe we get some out faster."

news.summary: Diablo 4's next class is Amazon, Blizzard announced during the BlizzCon opening ceremony , but it won't be com

content.v: Diablo 4's next class is Amazon, Blizzard announced during the BlizzCon opening ceremony , but it won't be coming as part of a new expansion. Instead, Blizzard will sell the Amazon as a separate DLC class pack in the first half of next year.

The addition of the Amazon isn't exactly a surprise. First, it's an iconic class from Diablo 2, so it's a bit of a no-brainer there. Alongside the nostalgia factor, Diablo 4's latest expansion, Lord of Hatred, also took players to the literal home of the Amazons, Skovos. They featured heavily in the expansion's story but were not a playable class, with the expansion instead adding the Paladin and Warlock to Diablo 4's class roster.

While the Amazon isn't coming until 2027, Diablo 4's next season, Hell's Legacy, is coming much sooner. The season kicks off next week on September 15 and will celebrate the franchise's 30th anniversary and feature the return of enemies, locations, and items from previous Diablo games. That will include the return of Deckard Cain, who will take players on a journey to confront Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto, meaning the Lord of Terror himself will finally make an appearance in Diablo 4.
Though it leaked ahead of time, Diablo 4 is officially coming to the Switch 2 as well, with a Lord of Hatred collection that includes both of the game's expansions.

news.title: 《守望先锋》正在重塑两个最受批评的角色
news.summary: After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon

content.v: After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , both Roadhog and Sombra will be receiving major reworks, with Sombra pivoting to being a support hero and Roadhog undergoing changes to make him more of a team player.
Shortly after the reveal, Overwatch shared an updated look at both character's Hero kits. Below is a comprehensive overview of their changes:
Sombra
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.45-AM-1.png?w=636

Of the two, Sombra is receiving the most significant redesign, pivoting from a Damage hero to Support. Whereas she used to be most effective at fast-paced, ambush-style combat, she will now be far more useful in team settings. Her Hack ability has been replaced with Hotfix, which allows her to freely hack health packs and enemy deployables as well as heal allies. Cyberspace replaces Virus, and sees Sombra launch a projectile that heals allies and weakens enemies. With the exception of CTRL ALT ESC, all of Sombra's Perks have been adjusted, and she now boasts Support passives.
Roadhog
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.35-AM.png?w=636

By comparison Roadhog's changes are far less dramatic, with the most notable being the removal of Scrap Gun's Alt Fire. In lieu of this skill, Roadhog has been given Trash Compactor--an ability that allows Roadhog to absorb enemy projectiles and turn them into an explosive ball of scrap. This makes him far more effective as an actual Tank, granting him what seems like a fairly effective barrier that will hopefully deter players from abandoning their team in search of smaller firefights.
In addition to these changes, Blizzard has announced Overwatch's 54th character, Doctrine , is coming October 5.

news.title: 《守望先锋》最新吸血角色将游戏进一步推向奇幻类型
news.summary: Since its inception, Overwatch has positioned itself as an optimistic, science-fiction-driven world. Although

content.v: Since its inception, Overwatch has positioned itself as an optimistic, science-fiction-driven world. Although some characters have introduced an element of the fantastical--the addition of the magical Wuxing University being the most notable tonal shift--the team behind the hero shooter has always prioritized scientific explanations for its heroes incredible abilities. Its newest character, however, seems to venture further into fantasy than ever before.

Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , Doctrine is the next support hero coming to Overwatch. Oh and fun fact, he's a vampire--or vampire-inspired, at the very least. With a sceptre that heals and speeds up teammates yet dishes out major damage to enemies, Doctrine is an extremely powerful hero with a high mechanical floor. Interested in putting your skills to the test and giving him a whirl? You're in luck, as Doctrine's limited-time hero trial has officially kicked off and will run until September 14.

In addition to his sceptre, Doctrine can also unleash a swarm of bat drones, infuse allies, and "manipulate life force." Blizzard has described the hero as the "ultimate vampire fantasy." Below is a more thorough look at his Hero kit:
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.32.20-AM.png?w=636

While Doctrine (real name Tamuka Yeukai) hails from Zimbabwe, he is accompanied by the Escort map Watchpoint: Grimsvotn, which depicts the Icelandic prison he is seen escaping in his debut cinematic. Doctrine joins Overwatch on the side of Talon, his trailer revealing him to be a close friend of Doomfist. This relationship also expresses itself mechanically, as the Overwatch team stated his kit complements Doomfist's extremely well.
In other Overwatch news, the team shared that two of its most criticized legacy characters, Sombra and Roadhog, are undergoing major changes .

news.title: 《星际争霸》正式回归，但形式截然不同
news.summary: Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but

content.v: Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but that game won't be in the traditional real-time-strategy genre the franchise is known for. Instead, the new StarCraft game is described as an open-world shooter.

The news was revealed as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony . However, that's essentially all we know, as the new game-referred to only as StarCraft--won't be released until 2030. As such, there were no further details shared about how it will play or anything else.

After Blizzard's Dan Hay said, "It's about damn time" that we returned to the interstellar war of StarCraft, we did see a cinematic trailer. Dominion forces are shown being pumped up after being trained as elite warriors. They're then sent onto the battlefield against a massive wave of Zerg forces.

When it does arrive, this will mark the first original game in the StarCraft franchise since the StarCraft II trilogy wrapped up with Legacy of the Void in 2015. The original game did receive a remaster, StarCraft Remastered, in 2017, but Blizzard's focus has otherwise shifted to its other franchises over the last decade.

While a StarCraft shooter had been rumored for some time, the reveal is still sure to come as a contentious piece of news for fans starved for a traditional StarCraft game. (The audible reaction from the crowd when "open-world shooter" was said was not necessarily one of elation.)

This isn't the first attempt to spin off the series into something else, as StarCraft Ghost was meant to be a stealth-action entry, but it was ultimately canceled prior to release. A recent report indicated that Nexon is seeking the StarCraft license in order to make a new game--possibly StarCraft III--so there may still be some hope for another StarCraft RTS.

Teases for a StarCraft revival began earlier this month, after the game's official website started to "glitch" and fans discovered hidden text logs. Each one appeared to be a secret transmission hinting at something on the horizon, with rumors circulating that it could be anything from a Helldivers-inspired co-op shooter game to the revival of StarCraft: Ghost.

But the main takeaway is that StarCraft is back, and in a big way. While it wasn't the first successful franchise to emerge from Blizzard, it still remains a key pillar for the company even after years of dormancy. The original StarCraft real-time strategy game and its Brood War expansion were huge hits upon release, and in South Korea, local internet cafes became hubs for competitive PvP that laid the groundwork for the rise of esports.

news.summary: Filling the void.

content.v: It's rare that a MOBA comes out, rarer that it manages to stick around, and perhaps rarest of all that it surges back to life after years on the backburner. While Heroes of the Storm never quite had its lights turned off , the constant downpour of new stuff you'd expect in a live service game did wind down. Until now.

At today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, it was announced that Xal'atath, the Harbinger of the Void, will be arriving in the long-dormant MOBA as a new hero—its first since Hogger was released all the way back in 2020. It's the first truly substantial update since 2022, as the game has only received light-touch balance passes and bug fixes since Blizzard announced a shift to maintenance mode.

If you're unfamiliar, Xal'atath is a character from World of Warcraft's Legion expansion who started as a gnawing voice tucked away in the weapon slots of Shadow Priest players. More recently, she's become the villainous face of the current Midnight expansion.
It was also announced that another new hero would be revealed at some point in the future.
Xal'atath will arrive on the game's PTR this Monday, with a full release scheduled for Sep. 28. Follow the rest of today's Blizzcon news on our liveblog .

news.title: 暴雪嘉年华 2026 开幕式：所有最重要的公告和游戏
news.summary: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditi

content.v: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditional opening ceremony full of announcements and reveals for the company's biggest games--and a few surprises!

The biggest of these included the announcement that StarCraft will return in 2030, but this time, Blizzard is switching up genres as the sci-fi game goes from real-time strategy to open-world shooter. Diablo 5 was also announced, and World of Warcraft fans were spoiled with several reveals. In case you missed it, you can catch all the trailers and news below.
Heroes of the Storm
Heroes of the Storm is adding a new hero to its roster for the first time in six years, as Xal'atath is coming to the Nexus. You can try her out starting Monday on the PTR.
For The First Time In 6 Years, Blizzard Is Bringing A New Character To Heroes Of The Storm
A Diablo animated series is in development at Netflix
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Netflix-Diablo.jpg?w=636
The next announcement was about a Diablo animated series in development. Blizzard president Johanna Faries announced that it's being produced by Netflix.
"Diablo, I promise, is just the beginning," Faries teased. "To our Overwatch community, to our Warcraft community, and who knows, perhaps even some of our other universes."
Diablo Animated Series Coming To Netflix, Other Blizzard Franchises Teased
StarCraft returns in 2030

Ubisoft veteran Dan Hay was on stage to announce a brand-new StarCraft, which he described as an open-world shooter. The cinematic trailer showed off some gung-ho Dominion recruits training to be the best in the galaxy, but a few hours later, the remains of these fresh-faced soldiers were being scraped out of their warsuits.
StarCraft Is Officially Back, But It’s Taking A Much Different Form
Overwatch
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Overwatch.jpg?w=636

Overwatch director Aaron Keller was next on stage, dressed in an incredible jacket themed around the game. A new animated trailer was shown off, featuring popular characters like former Talon leader Doomfist, Reaper, Widowmaker, and Sombra as they assaulted a prison pulled from the Watchpoint Gibraltar map. The video ended with a tease of the ninth hero joining Overwatch this year, Doctrine.
Doctrine is a stylish techno-vampire

Miranda Moyer and Ben Bell from the Overwatch team described Doctrine as a Support-class hero who wields a scepter in battle. He mixes vampiric and techno powers together, and he can shroud enemies in darkness to hinder them. Doctrine can also use an "infuse" power to transform his next power. Doctrine's Hero Trial will be available for all Overwatch players later today.
Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
Big Overwatch changes are on the horizon
Sombra and Roadhog are getting some big reworks in Overwatch soon. Sombra is being turned into a Support-class hero, and a whole lot of content is planned for Season 5 of the game.
Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
A familiar face is coming to Diablo 4

Stay a while, and listen to what's next for Diablo! Tiffany Wat and Brent Gibson from the Diablo team announced that everyone's favorite Horadrim scholar, Deckard Cain, will return to Sanctuary soon. You can meet the fan-favorite character in Diablo 4 on September 15, when Season of Hell's Legacy launches.
Hell's Pawn is crossing over to Diablo Immortal
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-Spawn.jpg?w=636
Todd McFarlane's Spawn is coming to Diablo Immortal, which makes my inner '90s kid very happy. Honestly, could you ask for a better crossover character in the free-to-play mobile game?
Diablo 4 lands on Switch 2 in September
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Switch-2.jpg?w=636
And it'll be out on September 15! Switch 2 owners can grab Diablo 4: Age of Hatred Collection when it launches alongside the new Season of Hell's Legacy.
The Amazon is coming to Diablo 4
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Amazon.jpg?w=636

At long last, you can play as an Amazon in Diablo 4. This new take on the fan-favorite character will wield her signature bow, as well as the new javelin-class weapon. She'll be added to the game in the first half of 2027.
Diablo 4’s Next Class Is What You Expect But Isn’t Coming With A Full Expansion
Diablo 5 launches in 2029

With the Age of Hatred having concluded in Diablo 4, it's time for the next chapter in the series. Diablo 5 is currently scheduled to launch in Spring 2029, and things look bleak . In Diablo 5, the ancient Lord of Terror has returned and has conquered Sanctuary.
"What must you become, when the world has already fallen?" Wat teased for the dark direction of Diablo 5.
Diablo 5 Is Coming In 2029, Will Actually Star Diablo
Hearthstone's next expansion launches in October

What's next for Hearthstone? A new expansion and a new gameplay mechanic while you explore a narrative focused on the brawls between Old Gods that shaped the world of Azeroth. The new Assemble mechanic will allow you to fuse two cards together, and the Hearthstone team says that it's well aware that there'll be some "pretty busted" combinations. A pool of 250 cards can make use of this mechanic, and some of the combinations shown off are wild. You can try it out for yourself when Reign of the Black Empire launches on October 20.
Hearthstone's new hero is panda-ring to the Warcraft crowd
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Monk_8ae7c7.jpg?w=636
That's right, the Monk class is finally coming to Hearthstone, marking the first new class in four years.
Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
World of Warcraft: Midnight - Eclipse

World of Warcraft's Holly Longdale and Ion Hazzikostas introduced a new chapter in World of Warcraft's Worldsoul Saga, teasing "all gas and no brakes" in the new major content update. Eclipse will set the stage for a showdown with Xal'atath, and the new cinematic trailer showed her on the verge of a serious power-up.
World of Warcraft: The Last Titan

While Eclipse is the next big narrative chapter in World of Warcraft, The Last Titan is where Blizzard is promising a big shake-up to the MMORPG as it wraps up 20 years of storytelling. More details on it will be shared next year.
WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign

Longdale teased that Blizzard is "putting the war back in Warcraft" with the new campaign, Forsaken Kingdom, for Warcraft 3: Reforged. When can you play it? Today! Players will get to experience the fall of Lodaeron as Human armies took on mighty Orc forces. Other enhancements include a Definitive Edition graphical update, map editor improvements, and you can even select more units to command.
Warcraft Getting Its First New RTS Campaign In Two Decades–And It’s Playable Today
World of Warcraft: Forever

Azeroth is beckoning players back to where it all started, as we got a first look at World of Warcraft: Forever. The rumored Classic Plus mode for World of Warcraft will kick off with a beta on September 17 and launch on November 4. The game will include new dungeons, 10-20 player raids, the Skyborne as a playable race, account-wide perks, and new zones to explore.
WoW Forever Will Add All-New Content To Classic Azeroth This November

news.title: 粉丝在游戏展示会上发起攻击后，5 级 Boss 解决了 AI 的强烈反对
news.summary: Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted 'AI slop' in fo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/professor-layton-and-the-new-world-of-steam-1789228310265.png
Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted "AI slop" in footage of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village , DecaPolice, and more.

Concerns emerged following the studio's Nintendo Direct-style presentation earlier this week. Dubbed Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams, the show came with first looks at upcoming games, and it also happened to feature what fans suspected to be multiple examples of genAI.

Those who tuned into the 50-minute presentation spent more time talking about what they believed was evidence of AI use rather than the games, such as the Professor Layton remake, Yo-Kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, and DecaPolice. The footage causing a stir is mostly limited to background scenes, but it's the fact that fans had to question Level-5 in the first place that's turned the situation into a full-fledged controversy for the Japan-based studio.

Oh no Level-5 is DEFINATELY using Gen AI to "update" Professor Layton. Especially when you compare the original backgrounds to the new. So many weird details and inconsistencies were added. https://t.co/AjVNfgetkk pic.twitter.com/0tRQ9vKn03
⁉️ Dans le nouveau trailer de Yo-kai Watch 2 : Haunted Domain, Nathan a… changé de visage ?! 😭 #YOKAIWATCH Hier (gauche) / Aujourd’hui (droite) pic.twitter.com/Vr3rzwNPA7

"I was SO excited when Level-5 announced their big comeback with Professor Layton, Decapolice, Yo-Kai Watch, and more," one fan on X/Twitter said . "But seeing this much blatant genAI being used across their games… yeah, this ain’t it"
"You were a beautiful studio," another fan said . "Now you are nothing more than a disappointment to us. We don’t want this AI s**t."

Level-5 president and CEO Akihiro Hino, who also hosted the showcase with his own animated avatar, took to X/Twitter to calm the noise. His message was both an apology and an explanation, confirming that Level-5 did, in fact, use generative AI for some aspects of development.
Hino described Level-5's heavy use of AI as "experimentation with the latest technology," adding that the team "sincerely apologizes to anyone who found this off-putting."
I was excited about Decapolice but Level-5 AI use is disgusting to me. I can't support that. https://t.co/EpxgBtCnDo

"However, please be assured that all elements defining the appeal and individuality of our released titles— such as the scenario, character designs, and foundational settings — are created entirely by human hands," Hino said (via Google translate). "We utilize AI primarily to streamline the process of digitizing human-created assets; for instance, accurately converting original artwork into 3D polygon models. You can rest assured that the games we release do not contain content simply generated by AI."

Hino also defended how Level-5 has used AI so far, saying: "the time saved through AI-driven efficiencies has allowed our creators to dedicate more of their efforts to the true essence of creativity." For him and the rest of the team, the belief is that the finished versions of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village will still please fans in the end. Part of the reason it leaned so heavily on genAI this time around was so it could shrink "the development cycle for major titles from the current five years down to two."

"That said, we cannot deny that we made extensive use of AI this time, driven by a desire to deliver a presentation that was visually striking and easy to grasp," he continued. "We will take this experience as a learning opportunity for the future, so please look forward to Level-5’s next presentation."
pic.twitter.com/cict4COGTP

It's an explanation that hasn't gone over well in the Level-5 community. Replies to the post include fans still concerned about generative technology being used during development at all, fearing that affected games will be forever tarnished.

"Generative AI is trained on the stolen works of countless artists by tech companies to profit off their work, with the intent of replacing artists," one popular reply said . "By using it you replaced artists. You're profiting off of the skill of artists whose work has been stolen to power this software."

"I believe the human heart matters more than speed to market; surely it is better to take five years without using AI," another post written in Japanese said (via Google Translate). "If even a single asset is created using AI, the nagging worry — 'Is this image, piece of music, or line of dialogue made by AI or a human?' — would never go away. Isn't preserving that trust the most important thing?"

Hino didn't offer a specific game plan when it comes to how Level-5 will tweak its development plans going forward. For now, Professor Layton and the Curious Village, a remake of the original 2007 game, is slated to come to PC and consoles in 2027 . Another new game in the series, the New World of Steam , is due out this December.

news.title: Square Enix 正在努力修复《最终幻想 14》中的新兽王可能导致整个服务器崩溃的错误
news.summary: Beast mode activated.

content.v: Final Fantasy 14's latest job has just hit the proverbial shelves, and you know what that means: emergency maintenance to fix an extremely bizarre bug. On Sep. 8, the same day that the new beastmaster class dropped, Square Enix had to quickly patch out a bug where "if the player's character leaves the area due to a connection loss at the moment the pet uses a weapon skill that restores its master's HP, the server may crash."

Yes, this bug wasn't crashing the player's own game, but the server. While it's a pretty fringe set of circumstances that have to line up, it's easily replicated with a cheeky pull of one's ethernet cable, so it makes sense that Square Enix scrambled to address this before it became a catastrophe.

If you're unfamiliar with the beastmaster, it's one of the game's "limited jobs" along with the blue mage—basically, they are classes that can't be used to clear the main story quest or endgame dungeons, but they get a bunch of unconventional abilities to futz around with. They are broadly accessible side novelties, and with everyone piling in to check out the new one, it could have been a disaster had this bug been allowed to fester.

It's not the first time Square Enix has had to tackle a bizarre bug in the MMO. Just last year it won the coveted " Most Specific Bug Fix in a MMO " award from PC Gamer's Harvey Randall. With that one, players could get disconnected from the server if they listed an auction house item in a specific zone with an asking price set "between 44,442 gil and 49,087 gil."

It's the sort of bug that sounds like it was made up as an illustrative example of how bizarre bugs can be. But whether it's the funniest in recent memory is still up for debate, given the ' random buffs ' incident from back in 2023.

news.title: GTA：1961 年的伦敦充满了伦敦风格的影射，而且比鲍比的头盔还要坚硬
news.summary: In your end-o.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

In the wake of GTA 6, series veterans will wax nostalgically about the era of Rockstar expansion packs. No sooner had you finished The Lost and Damned, they'll tell their nurse in between spoonfuls of prunes, The Ballad of Gay Tony landed on your hard drive. There was none of this 'waiting a decade for a new GTA' nonsense.

Fewer will remember the first age of Grand Theft Auto, when even the expansion packs had expansion packs. Really—GTA birthed GTA: London, which in turn begat GTA: London 1961. The latter was released for free online in the summer of 1999, where only a subset of disc-spinning PC gamers were ever likely to find it. Which might have been for the best. Because GTA: London 1961 is perhaps the most punishing visit to the British capital ever conceived. Even including 28 Days Later, and the press reception of Meghan and Harry.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/h2qMwZfBYSBUaHjcsq5TuX.jpg

The original Grand Theft Auto already demanded a lot from its players—splicing a nascent open world structure with the limited lives and scorechasing of the arcades. To pass a given level, you'd need to complete several back-to-back chains of missions, thereby building a sufficient multiplier to reach the target score. Getting busted would halve your multiplier instantly. And since cops only needed to bump into you to effect an arrest, like a ghost in Pac-Man, you could easily wind up back at square one, with a dwindling pool of missions to pick from.
GTA: London 1961 is perhaps the most punishing visit to the British capital ever conceived.

To this brutal ruleset, the designers of GTA: London 1961 decided to add mission timers tighter than Adam West's batsuit. How does 20 seconds from East Bermondsey to West Southwark strike you? Or 30 from Westminster Palace to the City of London, where the bankers work? Even in GTA's shrunken top-down metropolis, it's an extraordinary ask—only possible if you pick precisely the right route, floor it, and somehow avoid any serious collisions along the way. "You got to be a little faster," explains your cock-er-ney paymaster, helpfully. "Or Harold'll have your guts for gardening with!"

And should you fail, even once? Those same gangsters will throw you out on your arse, ending the mission with no way of recovery. "This ain't some leisurely afternoon stroll with a stunning bird! This is major international crime, and time and crime waits for Norman, as Harold once said! You blew it, you nob!"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ymKF2s98uyv5FFaL6s98uX.jpg
I can't help but wonder how Harold can afford to be so picky with his drivers. If he's got Charlie Croker on the other end of the blower, why is he talking to me in the first place? Good riddance.

Except, without the largesse of old Harold, making money in London is no walk in the park. It might be a drive through Hyde Park, knocking down pedestrians in precise combos to try and max out your score the hard way. Or a slow, repetitive shift at the docks, feeding endless stolen cars to the crane in exchange for £100 notes. I scuppered my chances there by rolling an enormous red bus halfway into the Thames, blocking the crane and making future deliveries impossible.

Thankfully, I'm not the first person to be astonished by the obscenity of those mission timers. And GTA: London 1961 belongs to a time when in-game values could be easily tweaked via notepad files buried on your PC. A kind fellow traveller named Duckilous left instructions on the GTA Forums —an added 30 seconds here, an extra 2375 frames there—and it's no exaggeration to say that those simple inputs are transformative. "I am not a modder for the classic GTA games," my saviour writes. "This is something I just figured out in one day."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/49ZjmymmLgsZHF8artnrtX.jpg

Duckilous' GTA London: 1961 remains a frantic, frazzling dash through pixellated renderings of some of the world's most famous landmarks. But that extra inch of breathing room makes all the difference. Another half a minute per mission means you actually have time to read what your objectives are before haring off towards them.
That extra inch of breathing room makes all the difference.

You even get a moment to appreciate the, ah, prose: "What the hell are you doing? You left Mr Caukenbolls all alone. Now some gang has kidnapped him. You'd better find him and get him back here, unharmed! A miss is as good as a moron in this game, mate."

Crucially, the added time means you get to complete more objectives, and therefore access more missions further down the chain. Among GTA: London 1961's scenarios are the theft of a rival gangster's clothes during a pond swim, the filming of a bespoke documentary for Harold to watch at home, and the first-ever implementation of driveby mechanics in the series. There's even a bit of Bond-lite cruising in a Jaguar with a union jack paint job, called the Jug Swinger.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xFMSSj59xQrKxsy4LouqjX.jpg

But it's all over pretty fast. This, I now realise, is what the vicious timers were likely covering for: a damning scarcity of scripted missions. I managed to complete four of seven and, having failed the others, was left scraping around to make up the shortfall in my level score.

When run over with a 3x multiplier, policemen yield 3000 points each, and I calculated I'd need to pancake only about a dozen to reach the target. But eventually, even the coppers stopped showing up. London's streets turned eerily quiet, as if every last response unit in Scotland Yard had at last been totalled or exploded. The war was over.

In the end, I was combing the city from Camden to Camberwell, searching for one last way to eke out enough damage to sufficiently impress London's criminal class. And eventually, I found it: a tank parked on a football field. The cars and buildings of Westminster rocked with concussive force as rockets flew. Buckingham Palace's window bill for 1962 would be enormous. But I could finally say I'd completed GTA's toughest challenge to date. Give or take a 30 second timer.

news.title: 《最终幻想 14》时髦的全新 Roguelike 模式让我对《Evercold》的战斗改进大为兴奋，如果它能有一半的怪异，那它就是赢家
news.summary: Who let the dogs out?

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice.

I've had a little time to muck around with Final Fantasy 14 's new Beastmaster limited job—for the uninitiated, a limited job is sort of like a minigame. Not an actual class you can take into current raids or dungeons, but a side-activity that uses the game's combat system to create something new.

The Beastmaster can tame and use creatures in combat. And for the first 30 levels, I was mostly just filling out my little book of monsters in a pleasant haze. I like the job's core combat mechanics, which involve pairing up axe strikes with specific monster abilities to form combos, but grinding in the overworld doesn't do much to show that off.
Where the Beastmaster really shines is in the Crucible of the Unbroken, the limited job's roguelike mode.

I was mostly expecting a straightforward list of bosses to push over via FF14 fun, but played-out combat mechanics, and there is some of that demand. But it's mixed with an overarching minigame of strategy and ability usage that has me watering at the mouth for whatever strange, eldritch things Evercold is cooking up.

For context, Evercold will be introducing "Evolved" jobs —a means to escape the game's rote, two-minute cooldown homogenization that's plagued it for years. During the look we've gotten at these, it seems Square Enix wants to reintroduce job identity to each of the existing jobs by giving them something weird.

For example, the Paladin gets defensive abilities they can essentially "parry" with, unlocking huge punishes if they time them moments before a powerful blow lands. The Dragoon will get an ultimate jump ability and, while it is still being deliberated, the developers have teased the idea of giving the Dragoon a 90% damage resistance buff while they're up in the air. The Dragoon is a DPS job. This'd be unprecedented.

But it's hard to tell, with any development studio, where the hype ends and the overpromising begins. Will Square Enix be brave enough to commit? The Crucible of the Unbroken tells me they very much might.

Granted, this is an isolated bit of content off the beaten path, but it's clear that Square's been using it to experiment with job design that's more reactive to the encounter at hand, rather than just hitting the same buttons every two minutes.

You get given 10 of your collected pets to bring with you into your run—while you can bring three into a battle at a time. Each of these critters have a "Trick" ability, which hits a certain elemental damage type (and enables your Axe combos), a "Tempered Release" ability, which is unique to that creature, and a "Borrow" ability, which is unique to that creature's type.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zehufFSUpSQYuPR38eFcYd.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kdST9paSNxmQNA5oM6PhWd.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/892b5QCtDJTXQGhPccSNad.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2tiT4m8WQPj7KqKvnvHsbd.png

Doing well in crucible battles isn't about memorising your rotation by rote—or even by memorising mechanics, really, although the Crucible is punishing if you mess anything up, as any good roguelike should be. It's about bringing specific beasties to specific encounters and using them in specific phases.

For example, one boss I fought had a mid-fight phase in which four flames steadily advanced to the centre, slapping me with a debuff if I didn't kill them in time. They're weak to water, so I brought out my favourite crab bro, borrowed his "you can spam water attacks now" ability, and melted them down.

This extends to a lot of other mechanics, too. If you want to interrupt a cast, you need a specific critter for that. If you want to endure a massive tankbuster, you'll need to borrow a defensive ability from one of your animal friends.

You aren't just deciding which scissor, paper, or rock to use—the crucible forces you to be deliberate in a few ways. Firstly, these bosses constantly output damage. You can choose to have the boss either attack you or your pet, but health loss is permanent and can only be restored by items or campfires.

You don't want to die, because then you fail the run, but you also might want your pet to live for a future battle—or conversely, you might have a (literal) sacrificial lamb. Furthermore, swapping between pets has a long cooldown, so you're going to have a beastie out for a while. It's a little like the game's already-existing Bard job, wherein you have three songs that last for 45 minutes a pop.

It's extremely compelling, and I've legitimately felt like I'm putting together custom strategies for each fight—all the while juggling my own rotation and dancing between AoE danger zones. And it gives me hope that Evercold's new evolved jobs will be super weird, too.

Maybe not just as weird. Obviously, Beastmaster's occupancy as a limited job gives it a lot more room to experiment—but the Crucible does feel like a testing ground for concepts in future raids and fights. I can easily see a world in which a specific set of jobs are able to simply skip entire mechanics because of their unique abilities.

I don't want a puzzle for every old casual dungeon boss, mind—but I do want those same eureka moments where you realise you've got the perfect answer to a mechanic on your action bar, rather than just memorised as 'this particle effect means we stack up, this one means we spread'. If "evolved" combat design is half as experimental as Beastmaster, then Final Fantasy 14 will have finally shaked off the dust .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UjCJY9gjRfatHZjCuGMrhR.jpg

news.title: 《黎明行者之血》是一款好游戏，但稍加改动就会使其成为一款出色的角色扮演游戏
news.summary: The prologue promises something the game never quite delivers.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ckZUwfxbakq5yXMJMfSmBW.png

Welcome to Dungeon Master , PC Gamer's regular RPG column, where Online Editor Fraser Brown delves into PC gaming's most beloved and enduring genre. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke.

The Blood of Dawnwalker is good stuff—over the course of a week I drank deeply and had a grand ol' time walking on walls and carving people up with my monstrous claws. But as a choice-laden RPG that promised a lot of agency, it ended up being a bit of a disappointment. There were plenty of choices to be made, but rarely did they leave an impact on either the world or the white bread protagonist, Coen of Laslea.
Rebel Wolves made Coen in the mold of Geralt of Rivia, in that he's a defined character who you can nudge in different directions, but Coen is no Geralt.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FFY9R7fKJAew58Lp52P7y6.jpg

By The Witcher 3 , CDPR had the two previous games to lean on, along with a boat-load of books, which helped the studio create a well-defined, consistent character no matter what choices you made. Coen, on the other hand, is just at the start of his journey , and in Dawnwalker, his defining feature is that he loves his family.

Look, I don't mind Coen. Will de Renzy-Martin gave a good performance, but it's hard to do much with a character who's just a nice boy. And while the writers did some interesting stuff in regards to Coen's childhood trauma and his obligation to his family—is it love, or is he trapped in a prison of responsibility?—he's mostly just a pleasant dude.

The choices players face fall into the traditional binary category, which in this case means you can either choose a Coen who is willing to do everything to save his family except become a monster, or a Coen who is willing to do everything to save his family including becoming a monster—but is still mostly a good egg.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/d6uwN8SCa4dfkQmDM2NAe8.jpg

Unfortunately, this changes surprisingly little. If you let a vrakhir collaborator go free or murder them, it might change how you feel about the character you're playing, but the world itself couldn't care less. Until the epilogue, most choices you make happen in the background, in a vacuum, and the choices you'd expect to have the greatest impact, like how you choose to defeat Brencis, are largely detached from the kind of Coen you've been playing for 40 hours.

I played Coen as wholesome and naive, but I still found myself able to get every ending. It just came down to which route to Brencis I decided to settle on at the last moment. How I comported myself had no impact. And even though I tried to be consistent when it came to how I roleplayed Coen, the voice direction would often take things in a very different direction, transforming, for instance, what appeared to be a neutral statement into an angry criticism.

This is something that often bugs me in voice-acted RPGs. The acting and direction can dramatically change the tone of a line in a way that feels incongruous to the rest of the conversation, and this happens so much in Dawnwalker. It's something CDPR deftly resolved in The Witcher by making Geralt incredibly stoic. Doug Cockle has plenty of range, but when he's playing Geralt it's extremely subtle, which maintains the consistency of each dialogue sequence.
Final countdown
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xxrGtHGdM5PQL2WEVNeRoJ.jpg

But Dawnwalker has something most RPGs don't: a ticking clock. And while the most obvious benefit is the sense of urgency it blesses the game with, it also seemed like a promising roleplaying mechanic—helping players to better define their version of Coen by determining what's most important to him.

This is felt most keenly in the prologue, before Coen becomes a dawnwalker. You have one day to do some chores before everyone in the village has to visit the church to get drained by their undead rulers. It's impossible to do everything . Do you focus on helping your fellow villagers? Or do you spend the day hanging out with your family? What's most important to your Coen?

Even during this single day, there's a tangible sense of time moving inexorably forwards. For instance, early in the day you'll meet your siblings, who want to spend time with you and go down to the river. If you decline initially, later you'll find that they've gone to the river by themselves, and you can meet them down there, or just continue to ignore them. There's a schedule.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MkE3iUWNMfrRXLJkVu9bVG.png

This promise of time's fickle nature is largely done away with after you complete the prologue. You have 30 days to finish the game—if you want to save your family, anyway—but within those 30 days any time pressure is just an illusion. You'll meet people on the second day who want your help, and they'll still be waiting around for you by the 25th day.

In my entire playthrough, outside of the prologue, I only encountered a single quest where I ran out of time. I could have caught up with an old friend who joined the rebels, but once I'd completed all the quests for the organisation, they mobilised to take on Brencis, at which point I could no longer hang out with my pal. According to our guide lead Sean Martin, who completed every quest Dawnwalker offered, he only found one other example of this happening.

So I never had to make any tough choices. Do I hang out with the mean vampire lady and learn more about the monster I'm becoming? Or do I have a magical adventure with the friendly witch who wants to help me save my family? It doesn't matter because I can always do both.
Evening plans
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4Zj3DgW9d5cR4oHgvgwes6.jpg

There's definitely an argument for making Dawnwalker's time limit 20 days instead of 30, but I think that might make the adventure feel too rushed. Instead, sticking with 30 days but putting individual quests on a timer would make a lot more sense. This forces you to make decisions about how Coen should spend his time every day, as well as giving NPCs more agency, while still letting you do a lot.

Being made to choose between staging a jailbreak or assassinating a high-ranking soldier is a much more effective way to establish who Coen is compared to the extremely common choice of: drink a barrel of blood or smash a barrel of blood. It also leaves room for meaningful consequences—like discovering the terrible fate of the prisoners if you opted to do the assassination mission instead, and having other characters actually reference it.
What's frustrating is that you occasionally see glimmers of this, like the time of day you do a quest subtly changing how things play out.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4fRTiVosLRDw2tSSKk8cqH.jpg

When I tried to meet up with the rebels for the first time, I played through it twice: once during the day, and once at night. At night, I found a rebel being harassed by soldiers, who were immediately hostile to me. After I quickly murdered the soldiers, the rebel took me to meet her friends, but I sensed a trap thanks to my supernatural skills, and avoided getting my leg stuck in a snare.

Attempting this in the afternoon, I was actually able to talk to the soldiers instead of killing them immediately. Rather than fighting, I bribed them to leave the rebel alone. But when I was brought to meet her fellow rebels, I walked right into the snare trap.

This was cool! Though it didn't actually matter at all. In vampire form, even though I avoided the first trap, the rebels ended up jumping me and chaining me to a tree. No matter the time of day, the end result was the same.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UyPkx27rQ7fixw27odnigB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8H2F3G7p2ZVDt9oX4BcuHT.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

news.title: 根本抢不到！苹果18Pro一机难求 涨价千元开抢秒空
news.summary: iPhone 18 Pro开售一分钟售罄，涨价千元仍一机难求，官网被挤崩。

content.v: 9月12日晚20点，iPhone 18 Pro系列正式开启预售，火爆程度远超预期。今年新机涨价千元，起步价来到9999元，仍未挡住抢购热潮；开售前全平台预约总量突破450万，热门配色与大内存版本开售瞬间被一抢而空，不到一分钟便全线售罄，发货周期排到半个月之后，其中Pro Max酒红色版本货源最少。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122212011990.jpg
社交平台上大量果粉晒出抢购实况：卡点下单直接页面崩溃，连苹果官网都被流量挤崩。随后，苹果18抢不到迅速冲上热搜。即便成功下单，部分用户发货也要等上大半个月。
供需紧张的核心原因，是苹果今年砍掉了iPhone 18标准版，全部购机需求集中到Pro系列，放大了供货缺口。据快科技查询，京东自营渠道iPhone 18 Pro Max预约量突破170万、iPhone 18 Pro突破240万，两款合计超410万。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122212417672.png
据蓝鲸新闻报道，发布会当晚各大黄牛社群便开启大批量收机，新机未开售就已有人锁单。黄牛行情火热主要源于国行与港版价差拉大：256GB国行9999元、港版约8985元，差价超千元；2TB Pro Max国行21499元、港版约18699元，差价达2800元，跨区套利空间显著，大批黄牛准备从香港拿货销往内地。
